# 2 Baruch Chapter 86 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Baruch's Letters

---

**1** "And now I command you that when you have received this letter, you read it in your assemblies with care."

**2** "And meditate upon it, above all on the days of your fasts; and remember me through it, even as I remember you through it."

**3** "And fare you well, always and in good health; and forget not the Lord our God."

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Paragraph divisions follow the sense units of the source.*
